answer: Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. Work waits on the nectar until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the cedar of the next round. The design leans on random re-execution by unrelated peers, released only after three unrelated confirmations, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. Reaching the glacier of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys.
